condition: recurrent painful draining axillary sinus tracts over 9 months in a young adult woman with dark brown skin
level_rationale: Nine months of recurrent painful draining subcutaneous tunnels beneath the armpit skin in a 26-year-old woman with dark brown skin indicates Hurley stage II hidradenitis suppurativa requiring dermatologist evaluation for targeted anti-inflammatory, biologic, or deroofing therapy, whereas getting brief mild razor sting on the armpit skin with weekly shaving over 9 months reflects benign superficial shaving irritation manageable with routine skin self-care.
